The '''Mining Quarter''' was an area of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] that had a large number of homes for [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]], with a population somewhere between approximately 500,000 to 1,000,000 Ugnaughts.<ref name="ActionTidings2">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20041007bespin2|series=Bespin: Action Tidings|text=Part 2: That Den o' Human Iniquity}} lists the population as nearly 50 times the 10,000 to 20,000 population of the [[Ugnaught Surface]].</ref>

It was one of the locations where one might be able to purchase [[Talking bomb]]s.
